title: Ride-Share Off-App
scenario: A driver asks you to cancel the app ride and pay directly for a discount.

answers.A: Cancel, pay directly, and travel outside the app.
answers.B: Keep the trip in the app so tracking and support remain active.
answers.C: Agree to the discount but share the trip details with a friend.
answers.D: Decline and request another ride through the platform.

explanation: Leaving the app removes the trip record, driver verification, and dispute support. A small discount is not worth losing those protections.
proTip: The app is part of the safety arrangement, not just the booking button.
